# Loading R package
```{r}
library(pacman)
p_load(ggplot2, ggrepel)
```


```{r}
# Setting group
Group_1 <- "Jiangmen"
Group_2 <- "Zhongshan"

# Read file
res.df <- read.table(file = paste0(Group_1, "-", Group_2, ".txt"), sep = "\t", header = T, row.names = 1)

# Acquiring Up- and Down-Regulated Genes
deg.up <- res.df[res.df$level == "Enriched", ]
deg.down <-  res.df[res.df$level == "Depleted", ]

# Customize differential type labeling based on |log2FC| >= 1 and adj.P.Val < 0.01
p <- ggplot(res.df, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(PValue), color = level)) +
geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
scale_colour_manual(values  = c('#D186B6', '#5086AB', 'gray'), limits = c('Enriched', 'Depleted', 'NotSig')) +
theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.background = element_rect(color = '#584B48', fill = 'transparent'), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18), axis.title.x = element_text(color = "#584B48", size = 10),
  axis.text.y = element_text(color = "#584B48", size = 10), axis.title.y = element_text(color = "#584B48", size = 14),
  axis.text.x = element_text(color = "#584B48", size = 14)) +
theme(legend.key = element_rect(fill = 'transparent', color = NA), legend.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent'), legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text(color="white"), legend.text = element_text(color="#584B48", size = 10),) +
geom_hline(yintercept = -log(0.05, 10), color = 'gray', size = 0.3) +
xlim(-25, 25) + ylim(0, 4) +
labs(x = '\nLog2 Fold Change', y = '-log10(padj)\n', color = '#584B48', title = paste0(Group_1, " vs ", Group_2)) +
  annotate("text", label = paste("Enriched Species is ", dim(deg.up)[1], "\nDepleted Species is",  dim(deg.down)[1]), x = -0, y = 4, size = 4, colour = "#584B48")

 
up <- deg.up[order(deg.up$PValue), ][1:4, ]
down <- deg.down[order(deg.down$PValue), ][1:6, ]
 
# Using functions from the ggrepel package
p1 <- p + 
geom_text_repel(data = rbind(up, down), aes(label = rownames(rbind(up, down))), fontface = "italic", size = 4, show.legend = F)
p1
ggsave(paste0(Group_1, " vs ", Group_2, " vol.pdf") ,p1, width=7, height=10)

```
